responsibility: Implements the generic directed-graph data model that diagnostics can attach as structured, machine-readable payloads. This file provides the executable behavior for diagnostics::digraphs::digraph, node, edge, and the lazy_digraph/lazy_digraphs helpers: property-bag attribute storage, cloning, SARIF graph/node/edge JSON generation, unique edge-id creation to satisfy SARIF requirements, and conversion of nested diagnostic graphs into GraphViz dot::graph form, including subgraph handling for child nodes and labeled nodes/edges. It is the core implementation that turns in-memory diagnostic graph objects into exportable SARIF and .dot representations for downstream formatters such as SARIF and HTML.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior for the generic diagnostic graph API declared in diagnostic-digraphs.h: property-bag accessors, cloning, SARIF edge-id generation, lazy graph materialization, and conversion of generic digraph/node/edge objects into GraphViz dot and SARIF output. Unlike the header, this is the implementation file rather than the interface/model declaration.
